vendor_step._label: integrated 2026-11-15: read by shaft_coupler() for the bore depth and shaft insertion limits; the file is the detail model
vendor_step.frame: file axis along Z at X -1.378, Y -0.015; 8 mm bore end at Z 3.156, 5 mm bore end at Z 28.256. Part frame: 5 mm end on Z=0
vendor_step.how_measured: mechloop's CAD kernel: bore cylinders 7.3 mm long behind a 0.2 mm chamfer; a 5 mm test shaft first overlaps the spider (its web) at 12.05 mm of insertion; an 8 mm test shaft first overlaps the spider (the rim of its 7 mm centre hole) between 8.5 and 8.7 mm. The first-inspection figure of 9.5 mm was where the 7 mm hole proper begins
vendor_step.note: past the 7.5 mm bore a shaft is no longer clamped; the insertion limits are where it would start to crush the elastomer

not_published_by_the_maker.axial_stiffness: not published (the page's 55 N.m/rad is TORSIONAL stiffness)
not_published_by_the_maker.consequence: the catalogue's angular_misalignment_deg = 1.0 stays an ASSUMED figure (typical of small jaw couplings); no parallel-misalignment or axial-stiffness figure is carried, and none was borrowed from larger couplings
